A1.justification: Both PDFs describe UniCo and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E. Retained material can be matched across appendix renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original UniCo experiments on ABC-multi, ABC-plane, and Building-PCC, including comparative reconstruction results, robustness tests, and ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds backbone comparisons, OmniObject3D reconstruction examples, and illustrated failure cases.

M1.justification: Eq. (6) changes the written membership cutoff from >= 0.5 to > 0.5. Confidence-pruning statements also become strict, matching the rule already stated in v1 Appendix B. This is a limited boundary-rule correction; the architecture, objectives, and online-target procedure remain unchanged, and an implementation change is not established.

E1.justification: v2 adds qualitative evaluation on real OmniObject3D scans with unseen freeform geometry, without training on them (Appendix C.2, Figure S2). ABC-multi, ABC-plane, and Building-PCC coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds CAPRI-Net as a direct-reconstruction comparator, printed as 'CARPRI-Net' and identified by reference 67. It was previously cited but not evaluated in this table. Existing comparison methods are retained.

E3.justification: The new Table S5 evaluates UniCo with PoinTr and ODGNet backbone configurations against corresponding completion-plus-extraction pipelines. Appendix C.2 also introduces evaluation on unseen real scans without training on that dataset. Previously stated splits, metrics, and training budgets remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 adds a backbone-dependence ablation (Table S5), qualitative out-of-distribution generalization examples (Figure S2), and failure cases involving missing primitives and incorrect semantics (Figure S3). Existing component, sensitivity, noise, projection, and transfer analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed disclosures, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added experiments introduce no new uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: New results include CAPRI-Net's CD 7.59, HD 15.18, NC 0.770, and FR 19.27 in Table 2, plus UniCo backbone results with CD 2.64 for PoinTr and 2.47 for ODGNet in Table S5. New qualitative generalization and failure examples are also reported. Matched existing numerical results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Eq. (6) makes a small formal-definition correction by excluding membership scores exactly equal to 0.5. The remaining mathematical formulation is retained; restoring a prediction hat and changing c_i to c_g are notation corrections. No new theoretical assumptions, propositions, or proofs appear.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about coordinated pathways, primitive proxies, online target updates, and reconstruction performance. The additional appendix evidence does not redefine these core contributions.

C2.justification: v2 attributes gains across backbones to the primitive pathway, extends the applicability discussion to approximating unseen freeform geometry, and identifies missing small primitives and semantic misclassification as failure modes. The main limitations concerning unstructured geometry and downstream solvers remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendices A–B retain the same implementation and access information, including feature/query counts, decoder configuration, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, loss weights, and project-page instructions. Hardware and runtime disclosures are also retained; the new experiments receive no additional implementation instructions.

R1.justification: v2 adds the OmniObject3D dataset citation and evaluates the already-cited CAPRI-Net. The related-work discussion and novelty positioning remain unchanged. Other reference changes are renumbering or bibliographic corrections.

P1.justification: v2 adds short appendix discussions and a C.4 failure-cases subsection, expands the acknowledgments, and corrects notation. The main narrative, section order, and most wording remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds a row to Table 2, a backbone-comparison table, and Figures S2–S3. Existing appendix Tables S5–S7 become S6–S8, with local reflow of tables, text, and references. Existing main figures and the overall visual design are retained.

improvement.justification: The added backbone comparisons, reconstruction baseline, and concrete failure examples strengthen validation and clarify practical behavior while preserving existing results. The freeform generalization claim is supported by only three illustrated examples and limited protocol detail, so the gains are useful but modest.
